task.description:
Implement PAR-01, PAR-02, PAR-03, PAR-04 per the validated (PASS after 2 rework cycles) design artefacts. This is a large, high-risk implementation -- read ALL FOUR design docs in full before writing any code, they specify exact function signatures, error taxonomies, and several scope items added during rework that are NOT optional: (1) PAR-01: events/events_archive as PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at) from creation, PK widened to (event_id, created_at), new plat_event_idempotency table, widened composite FKs on event_payload_store/webhook_deliveries. (2) PAR-02: daily plat_partition_maintenance scheduled job (following src/scheduler/ conventions) provisioning lead_months=2 future partitions for BOTH events AND events_ephemeral (not just events -- this was a rework-2 addition), plat_partition_catalog + plat_partition_maintenance_run_log tables. (3) PAR-03: DETACH/ATTACH retention logic, events_ephemeral table (hand-written, same PARTITION BY/composite-PK pattern as events), retention_class column on event_type_registry, RetentionClassForbidden guard in Registry.registerType() (app-level check + DB CHECK constraint chk_retention_class_protected_family) added during rework 1, AND the append-time retention-class routing in Store.append() (via a new registry.getType() call, NOT widening validatePayload()'s signature) added during rework 2 that routes retention_class='delete' events to events_ephemeral instead of events. (4) PAR-04: AttachScanRequired CHECK-before-ATTACH validation helper. ALSO REQUIRED (rework 1 scope): retire/remove src/event_store/store.zig::Store.archive() entirely (confirmed zero production call sites) and REWRITE its 4 dependent test cases (TC-ES-07-01, TC-ES-07-02, TC-ADP-11-02, TC-ADP-11-03 in tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig) to assert retirement and exercise the new PartitionRetention mechanism instead -- TC-ADP-11-02 specifically must exercise the new append-time routing + real ephemeral-drop behavior end to end (a non-protected delete-class type appended, landing in events_ephemeral, then dropped). Do not leave any of these 4 tests referencing the removed archive() function.

REWORK 1 (routed by ORCH after TEST-DESIGNER Step 3 found a genuine implementation gap, result.status PARTIAL):
- [BLOCKER] PAR-01 AC4 (StoreError.PartitionMissingForWrite: an append into a calendar month with no attached partition SHALL fail with this structured error, HTTP 503, rather than being routed to another partition or silently succeeding/failing generically) is UNIMPLEMENTED. src/design/par-01-monthly-range-partitioning.md's own Error taxonomy table (line ~533) specifies this StoreError variant and its HTTP mapping; StoreError (src/event_store/store.zig:39-72) declares no such variant, src/api/errors.zig has no mapping for it, and the append INSERT failure path (store.zig:600-618) catches the underlying Postgres 'no partition of relation' error generically as StoreError.TransactionFailed with no SQLSTATE-specific branch. Fix: add the PartitionMissingForWrite variant to StoreError, catch the specific Postgres error (likely SQLSTATE 23514/check violation or a partition-routing error -- verify the exact SQLSTATE Postgres actually returns for an INSERT targeting a RANGE-partitioned parent with no matching partition, by testing it directly) in the append path and map it to this variant instead of the generic TransactionFailed catch-all, and add the src/api/errors.zig HTTP 503 mapping. Write a real integration test proving this (append into a month with no partition attached, assert the specific error and HTTP 503, per PAR-01 AC4's exact wording).
- [MINOR, address if straightforward, do not let it block PASS if genuinely low-value] PAR-02 AC3/AC5, PAR-03 AC4/AC5/AC6, PAR-04 AC3/AC4 have correct implementations but thin/missing direct test coverage per TEST-DESIGNER's detailed Gap notes in tests/specs/PAR-02.md, PAR-03.md, PAR-04.md -- close what is genuinely quick/valuable (e.g. PAR-02 AC5's missing EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED emission call site sounds like it may be a real gap, not just a missing test -- check it), leave documented rather than blocking if it requires artificial-latency injection or similarly disproportionate test infrastructure (e.g. PAR-04 AC3).
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in PAR-01, PAR-02, PAR-03, PAR-04 is implemented
Store.archive() fully removed, zero remaining references to it anywhere in src/ or tests/
TC-ES-07-01/02 and TC-ADP-11-02/03 rewritten and passing, exercising the new PartitionRetention mechanism (not the removed archive())
ES-07 and ADP-11 (both RELEASED) remain genuinely satisfied by the rewritten tests -- not just renamed, actually re-verified against the new mechanism
No mocks/stubs/fakes; all DB access via real PostgreSQL through the Pool
Real unit + integration tests written and passing for all new code, with own addTest/build.zig wiring (verified real by deliberate-break test)
